versions.changelog:
- Initial release of sonoscli skill.
- Control Sonos speakers: discover devices, check status, play, adjust volume, and manage speaker groups.
- Access 50+ AI models for image and video generation, text-to-speech, speech-to-text, music, chat, web search, document parsing, email, and SMS tasks via SkillBoss API.
- Unified API key required for all functionalities.
- Provides usage examples and documentation for each feature in SKILL.md.
